task.title: Triage isolated coordination queue before replay
task.summary_zh: 盤點被隔離的舊 coordination dispatch，不直接丟回 active queue；先分類為已完成/過期/仍需 replay，建立安全 replay policy 與 dry-run 檢查，避免舊 front-sync/runtime-worker 事件再次淹沒 blueprint execution。
acceptance: 能列出 backup queue 中 coordination events 的分類摘要
有 dry-run replay 指令或腳本
只會 replay 仍有效且未 terminal 的事件
active execution queue 不被舊事件覆蓋
task.next: Closed coordination queue triage and replay policy: isolated backup is classified, replay candidates file is empty, and future replay must be manual/fresh rather than bulk-appending old queue lines.
review_notes_zh: 依使用者指示不再派 auto worker；此為行政核准。已核對 scripts/orchestrator_queue_triage.py 可 dry-run 分類，備份 115 events 產出 0 replay candidates，policy 明確禁止 bulk append 並要求逐一 republish fresh event。

handoffs.message: Manual closeout ready: backup queue triage reports 115 old events, 0 auto replay candidates, and replay policy forbids bulk append while preserving manual review buckets.
Administrative approval: triage and replay policy are sufficient for safe manual handling without redispatching the old coordination queue.
